name: Cortex — Apple and Liquid Glass inspired interface

references.title: Apple Design Resources — official macOS and iOS UI templates
Official iOS and iPadOS UI kit

implementation.type: Web adaptation of Apple platform conventions; not native AppKit or Apple's Liquid Glass renderer
implementation.fonts: Use the installed Apple system font via -apple-system; keep document and equation typography independent. Do not redistribute SF font files.
implementation.materials: Liquid Glass-inspired web material for navigation, toolbars, popovers and controls: backdrop blur, saturation, subtle edge highlights, tonal light scattering and damped press feedback. Solid content surfaces. No overlapping glass layers. Solid fallbacks for unsupported blur, reduced transparency and increased contrast.
implementation.geometry: Concentric radii: 20px cards, 12px inner controls at an 8px inset; 26px sheets. Progressive continuous corners with rounded fallback.
implementation.motion: 120ms feedback, 220ms content transitions, 360ms damped sheet entrances. These are Cortex web tuning values, not claimed Apple constants. No displacement under reduced motion.
implementation.accessibility: 44px touch targets, keyboard focus, increased contrast and reduced motion/transparency preferences.
implementation.surfaces: Overview and Tasks keep cards; Agent remains full-page with chats on the left and composer attachments; Docs retains its paper editor. Calendar keeps its Notion-style layout, continuous day scrolling, compact events, desktop inspector and phone bottom sheet, with Apple colors and controls.
implementation.colors: Apple Dark and Apple Light map to the current HIG system colors, including blue #0088FF light / #0091FF dark, system grays and documented increased-contrast variants for readable text and white-on-blue actions. Exact source values are recorded in apple-system-colors.json. Material opacities are web adaptations; other optional theme palettes remain user-selectable.
implementation.navigation: iPhone layout: floating bottom tabs for Today, Calendar, Tasks, Agent, and a More sheet. macOS layout: persistent sidebar and compact toolbar. Safe-area space prevents the tab bar covering calendar or composer controls.
